description: Public receipt of the D87 full software regression on the source tree of production dd7fac3 (tree 5f2653d, after the 2026-11-09 ADR179 promotion), run by the assistant at the owner's request. It records the second run of the day (NOT PASS, retained unchanged) and the third run (PASS). Software regression evidence only: not model quality, device acceptance, D89 or a release decision. No credentials, Vault material, DATABASE_URL or log content.

owner_request.context: after the ADR179 promotion (PR #48 develop -> staging, PR #49 staging -> production), the assistant asked whether to run D87 on the new production tree 5f2653d
owner_request.after_run_2_meaning: rerun D87 unchanged once the host is idle; the alternative of a CPU-pinning ADR for the reranker test was not chosen

source.checkout: detached at origin/production for both runs, then restored to develop

develop_at_run_time.difference_from_production: documentation only (PR #50); the D87 source-freeze scope has no difference (empty git diff)

source.tree_check: git rev-parse HEAD^{tree} equals git rev-parse origin/production^{tree}; the runbook's develop-equals-production check was not used because develop was ahead by documentation only
source.difference_from_previous_D87_tree_0b67d9: 20 source-scope files changed (PR #46 tests, PR #47 ADR179 code and tests); 4 added: src/infrastructure/sandbox_process.py, tests/process_probe.py, tests/test_process_probe.py, tests/test_sandbox_process.py

pytest_scope: pytest tests (benchmarks/tests not included), nothing excluded

Vault.credentials_read: in memory through infras/scripts/vault_static_secret.py, as designed

CORE.started_with: docker compose --profile core up -d (before each run)

run_2_not_pass.failure: ValueError reranker_evaluation_failed; log reranker_worker_nonzero exit_code=152 completed_rounds=2
run_2_not_pass.interpretation: 152 = 128 + SIGXCPU (24): the reranker worker reached its own RLIMIT_CPU of 480 s soft / 481 s hard (scripts/qwen_reranker_worker.py) during the third of three rounds
run_2_not_pass.reason_not_related: the reranker comparison code is unchanged and does not use the sandbox code changed by ADR179
run_2_not_pass.history: same failure mode as the 2026-11-02 full runs (5836 PASS / 1 FAIL, exit 152 after 2 rounds), when ADR150/ADR151 were accepted for one probe and one full only

solo_probe_after_run_2.purpose: analysis only; not a D87 run and not counted
solo_probe_after_run_2.conditions: CORE stopped, same production tree, LOCAL_ASSISTANT_EMBEDDING_COMPARE_LIVE=1, single test under /usr/bin/time -v
solo_probe_after_run_2.result: 1 failed in 241.94 s, exit 152 after 2 rounds
solo_probe_after_run_2.background_processes_observed: RustDesk, Claude desktop, k3s, GNOME Shell
solo_probe_after_run_2.cpu: AMD Ryzen 7 7700 (8 cores, 16 threads), governor powersave

idle_wait.criterion: busy logical CPUs (from /proc/stat) below 0.5 for 3 consecutive 30 s samples, up to 6 hours
idle_wait.processes_stopped_by_assistant: none; no owner application was closed

run_3_pass.precision_note: Times are given to the second and elapsed_seconds to two decimals; the private result.json keeps full precision. The warning's content is not recorded in this receipt.

residual_risk: When it passes, the reranker comparison uses an estimated 465-475 s (round wall time x 2 threads) of its 480 s CPU limit on this host, an estimated margin of about 1-3%. It exceeded the limit in run 2 (host load was not measured during that run) and in the solo probe right after it, where background load was present. The next D87 run should also start on an idle host. A durable remedy (for example the ADR151 CPU partition as a standing test environment) would need its own ADR and owner approval; the 480 s limit, model, profile and algorithm were not changed.

database_after_runs.method: read-only queries as the runtime role, after run 2 and after run 3

comparison.test_count_difference: +33 tests (5 from PR #46, 28 from PR #47) and +4 source files
comparison.CI_difference: CI's 6490 counts tests plus benchmarks/tests with exclusions and without DB/CORE; D87's 6233 is pytest tests only, nothing excluded, with real services.

scope: Software regression evidence for the source tree of production dd7fac3 (tree 5f2653d). It is not model quality, device acceptance, D89 or a release decision.
effect_on_D90: D87 for D90 must run on the exact content of the commit to be tagged (D90 dossier section 6, D87 runbook step 1). Run 3 matches production dd7fac3 now. Later docs-only commits (PR #50, the PR recording this run and the owner's filled D90 form) change the commit tree but not the D87 source-freeze scope; whether that difference is acceptable for the tag, or D87 is rerun on the final tag commit, is the owner's decision when filling the D90 form (named-exception box).
notes: The private result directories (result.json, pytest.log, source-freeze.json) are git-ignored and not published; only their names and the hashes above are public.
source_freeze_sha256 is the SHA-256 of the private source-freeze.json; log_sha256 is the SHA-256 of the private, redacted pytest.log.
Run 2 is retained as NOT PASS and is not replaced by run 3; run 3 was started only after the owner chose to rerun on an idle host.
The database check records row counts and the Alembic revision; it is not a row-by-row before/after comparison, and no Qdrant inventory is recorded here.
Earlier full results (6200 on 817 files, 2026-11-09 morning; 5889 on 750 files, 2026-11-03; 5759 on 732 files, 2026-10-27) remain history and are not rewritten.
